Lakshmi Agency | Architecture Blueprint
Executive Plan

1. Executive Overview & Philosophy

Lakshmi Agency is transitioning from traditional manual spreadsheet coordination to a fully automated, scalable digital ecosystem. The platform eliminates internal form fatigue by leveraging familiar Google Forms while retaining enterprise-grade automation: real-time slot deduction, order lifecycle tracking, countdown deadlines, and in-app alerts.

✨ Core Deliverables & Distinctions
  • External Google Forms with Zero Friction: Buyers submit orders and refunds via official Google Forms; no complex multi-step website registration required.
  • Automatic Stock & Slot Deduction: When a Google Form order is placed, available slots on the website are deducted automatically in real-time.
  • Intelligent Days & Payout Timers: Built-in Indian Working Days calculator (excluding weekends and public holidays) tracking the 20-day review deadline and 20–25 day payout period.
  • Distinctive Lakshmi Agency UI: Crafted around the agency's royal brand identity (Burgundy, Lotus Pink, Champagne Gold). Not a clone of third-party platforms.

Lakshmi Agency | Automated Order Lifecycle
Operational Engine

3. The 9-Step Agency Lifecycle Workflow

Every step defined in Lakshmi Agency's official policy is fully embedded into the platform's automated state machine:

1
Order Placement on Marketplace
Buyer purchases product through the official link provided by the Premium User (Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra).
2
Immediate Google Order Form Submission
Buyer fills https://forms.gle/ydedLFJwcef59hPD7. Google Apps Script fires an instant webhook to MongoDB. Deal slot is automatically reduced by 1. Order status is marked "ORDER_FILLED".
3
Product Delivery & Notification
Buyer receives delivery. Holding period clock begins ticking inside the system.
4
Review Submission Window (4–5 Days)
Buyer submits review/rating on the marketplace within 4 to 5 days of delivery (image review preferred).
5
Review Goes Live ➔ Fill Google Refund Form
Once approved by marketplace, buyer fills https://forms.gle/ssWFUKVpoxoKzKWc8 with Order ID, review screenshot, and payout UPI.
6
Strict 20-Day Form Completion Deadline
Refund form must be submitted within 20 days of delivery. The system displays a live countdown timer: "On Track - X day(s) left before form closes".
7
Disbursal in 20–25 Working Days
Upon refund form submission, the system triggers the 20 to 25 working days payout timer (automatically removing Saturdays, Sundays, and gazetted holidays).
8
Official Form Only Enforcement
Only verified form submissions are recognized for payment. Submissions sent via personal WhatsApp or chat are rejected.
9
Strict Marketplace Fee Exclusions
COD charges, marketplace convenience fees, platform charges, and supercoins are strictly non-refundable.

4. The Three Core Portals

The platform provides dedicated, role-tailored interfaces for seamless operation:

ADMIN Master Agency Command Center

• Deals Studio: Add deals with Brand Name, Marketplace, Price, Review/Rating slots, and Cloudinary image upload.
• WhatsApp Pitch Template Manager: Edit dynamic message templates (Order Message & Deal Announcements) with automatic tag replacement.
• User & Mediator Directory: Manage Premium Users (Mediators) and registered Buyers, approve accounts, search by mobile or email.
• Orders Master Ledger: View all agency orders, bulk status updates, transaction recording, and Google Sheet sync.

PREMIUM USER Mediator Operations Portal

• Orders Desk: Filter by "Needs Refund Only", track live 20-day countdowns, and inspect buyer details.
• 1-Click WhatsApp Client: Direct link to initiate customer WhatsApp chats with a single tap.
• Browse Deals & Slot Tracker: Live slot availability with automatic "Slots Full" indicators.
• 1-Click Order Pitch Generator: Generates ready-to-send WhatsApp promo text embedding their prefilled Google Form URL.
• In-App Notifications: Instant alert bell on order submissions and refund form arrivals.

USER Buyer Tracking & History Portal

• Order Progress Stepper: Real-time visual timeline showing holding days, review stage, and refund verification.
• Direct Refund Form Access: 1-click button to open the Google Refund Form when eligible.
• Profile & Bank/UPI Management: Store payment preferences securely for faster disbursements.
• Clean Zero-Spam Alerts: Updates received via in-app notification center without email spam.
